The '''Virgillian wheel lock''' was a type of archaic [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] produced by the [[Virgillian]]s. Due to a lack of access to blasters, the [[wheelock]] was used by the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]] in their efforts during the [[Virgillian Civil War]] within the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tessa Manchisco]] was skilled in the use of the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Virgillian wheel lock was mentioned in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] guide published in [[1996]] by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book was written by [[Kathy Tyers]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />
